mutations.contract_domain: Principal claim-value admission through admitClaimValue interface-wrapper traversal and finite depth/node/string accounting
mutations.reason: The selected break follows assignment of an invalid reflect.Value when an interface wrapper is nil. Replacing break with continue only rechecks the loop condition: value.IsValid is false, so short-circuit evaluation does not call Kind or Elem and immediately exits the loop. Both forms reach the same depth check, claim-node admission and decrement, then the same invalid-value return, without altering value, depth, string budget, claim-node budget, validation, normalization or copying. No caller callback or additional retained claim occurrence is introduced.
